# Metis

> Metis is an open-source coding agent harness engineered specifically to maximize the programming performance, code quality, and delivery reliability of LLMs (Claude, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Ollama).

Metis surrounds raw coding models with automated test verification loops, persistent project memory, and multi-agent role decoupling to eliminate hallucinations, broken syntax, and repetitive regressions.

## Documentation

- [Metis Overview](https://metisagent.tech): Official homepage and quickstart guide for the Metis coding agent harness.
- [Getting Started & Installation](https://metisagent.tech/docs): Complete setup guide for terminal CLI, desktop app, and multi-model configuration.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Wholiver/metis): Open-source codebase, issue tracker, release downloads, and developer documentation.
- [NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wholiver_hu/metis): Official npm CLI distribution for global terminal installation.

## Comparisons

- [Metis vs Modern AI Coding Agents](https://metisagent.tech/compare): Comprehensive 2026 feature matrix comparing Metis to Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Aider, and Codex.
- [Metis vs Claude Code](https://metisagent.tech/compare/metis-vs-claude-code): Deep architectural comparison of open harness vs proprietary CLI, test verification, and multi-provider support.
- [Metis vs Cursor](https://metisagent.tech/compare/metis-vs-cursor): In-depth comparison of autonomous CLI/desktop workflow vs IDE fork, context management, and offline privacy.
- [Metis vs Cline](https://metisagent.tech/compare/metis-vs-cline): Comparison of terminal-first execution, task verification loop, and multi-agent delegation vs VS Code extension.
- [Metis vs Aider](https://metisagent.tech/compare/metis-vs-aider): Architectural differences in multi-agent orchestration, dynamic compaction, and test self-healing.
- [Metis vs Roo Code](https://metisagent.tech/compare/metis-vs-roo-code): Analysis of autonomous test-driven delivery and memory retention.
- [Metis vs Codex](https://metisagent.tech/compare/metis-vs-codex): Comparison of autonomous closed-loop execution vs raw LLM autocomplete.

## Key Features

- [Closed-Loop Verification & Self-Healing](https://metisagent.tech/docs#verification): Executes builds, linters, and test suites automatically, intercepting stack traces and fixing errors before declaring tasks done.
- [Durable Memory & Dream System](https://metisagent.tech/docs#memory): Retains architectural decisions and distills cross-session workflow lessons into persistent project guidelines.
- [Multi-Agent Decoupling](https://metisagent.tech/docs#multi-agent): Separates Investigator, Builder, and Reviewer personas to prevent attention dilution and coding hallucinations.
- [Multi-Model Freedom](https://metisagent.tech/docs#models): Zero vendor lock-in with native support for Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek V3/R1, OpenAI, SiliconFlow, and local Ollama models.
